sources.title: RTMpose-OpenVINO (Face, Body, Hand) - GitHub
sources.snippet: Model Requirements: Face models: For facial landmark detection (68 or 106 keypoints) Body models: For human body pose estimation (17 or 133 keypoints) Hand models: For hand keypoint detection (21 keypoints) Note: You need to convert RTMPose models to OpenVINO IR format (.xml/.bin) using the OpenVINO Model Optimizer or export them directly from the original framework.
